english_text: We therefore support the concept of extending the SPC , but question the Commission proposal for an automatic six-month extension . We feel a variable length SPC extension would have been better and fairer , because the amount of incentive would better have reflected the costs of research . Of the options on the table , we therefore supported the three - plus three-month extension . We did not , however , support the option of a fixed four - or five - month SPC extension , because this risks being unfair to smaller companies .
